messages.content: Answer with a list of items, instead of bullet points use -. No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. write a description of the 20th century in an over-dramatic, biblical style

message.content:
- Iron castles rose from dust
- Kings fell to their knees
- Fire burned bright upon the hills
- Men wept for lost sons
- Steel giants marched across lands
- Peace broke into shards of glass
- Hope lingered in small hearts
- War consumed whole nations
- Light returned after dark nights
- Freedom rang like a bell
- New worlds were built from ruins
- Love endured despite all odds
- History wrote its final page
